title: Hot Springs Distilling
summary: A place-driven identity connecting illustrated spirit labels, copper-foil editions, merchandise, and a working digital home for an Arkansas distillery.
intro: One family of spirits, many expressions. A connected brand, packaging, and web system that carries the character of Hot Springs from the bottle to the browser.

heroImage.caption: Falls Creek, House collection. AI-generated packaging visualization using the designed label system; not production bottle photography.

role: Art direction · Identity & packaging · Web design · Engineering
internalNotes: Portfolio entry based on the October 2026 HSD artwork, presentation, and isolated website preview. The website is not a production-domain launch. Packaging, merchandise, and print scenes are existing AI-generated visualizations, captioned as such. Bear Clap bottle studies were omitted because they predate the October 9 artwork revision; the website capture shows the updated native hero artwork. Spring Works fictional release data remains concept material. No portable design-system contract adoption or measured business outcomes are claimed.
